H_protocol: H1 literal behavioral evidence at its own source plane; H2 real disposition amplified for comedy; H3 the particular behavior depends on the local punchline; H4 actual nonliteral comic license. L_protocol: L0 portable premise; L1 materially phrased/timed/tone-dependent layer; L2 register/pragmatic relationship materially matters; L3 specifically Japanese form centrally requires reconstruction. MIXED separates layers. No automatic L3 from Japanese script, idiom or fantasy terminology.
